# Rosa Parks and The Montgomery Bus Boycott

> A National History Day student project documenting Rosa Parks' life, the 1955-1956 Montgomery Bus Boycott, and their pivotal role in the American Civil Rights Movement.

This educational website provides a comprehensive exploration of Rosa Parks' arrest on December 1, 1955, the subsequent Montgomery Bus Boycott, and the broader civil rights struggle in Alabama. It includes primary sources, timelines, and historical analysis connecting these events to the NAACP, Browder v. Gayle, and the eventual passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

## Key Topics

- Rosa Parks
- Montgomery Bus Boycott
- Civil Rights Movement
- NAACP
- Browder v. Gayle
- Montgomery, Alabama
- Civil Rights Act of 1964
- National History Day
- African American History
- Raymond Parks
- Segregation
- Nonviolent Resistance
- Lyndon B. Johnson
- Spingarn Medal
- Primary and Secondary Sources

- [Home](http://rosparksandthemontgomerybusboycott.weebly.com/index.html): Homepage for National History Day project on Rosa Parks and civil rights

- [Connection to NHD Theme](http://rosparksandthemontgomerybusboycott.weebly.com/connection-to-nhd-theme.html): Explains Montgomery Bus Boycott's connection to NHD theme and significance
